caption: Riverside Jazz Band
history:
Riverside Jazz Band
This photograph was taken in 1955, the band consisted of local lads who practiced at the Bull’s Head in Syston, (now the Social Club).
Left to right: Ron Goffer, Rod Smith, Daz Botterill, Roger Cooke and Chap Smith. All the musicians (except Ron Goffer) lived on Church Hill Road, (now Lea Close) at the time the photo was taken.
